view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a warehouse aisle with polished concrete floors and exposed ceiling infrastructure. Stacks of palletized goods are centrally located, while an orange forklift is partially visible on the right. Yellow safety barriers line the left side, and a numbered sign '2' hangs overhead. Lighting fixtures illuminate the space, revealing distant structural columns and a doorway in the background.

objects.label: palletized boxes
objects.observation: Multiple stacks of dark blue boxes wrapped in plastic, resting on wooden pallets. Positioned centrally in the aisle, they are arranged in three main groups. The boxes show printed labels and diamond-shaped logos. They are supported by the pallets and sit directly on the floor, with no visible supports beyond that.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange and gray forklift, branded 'STILL', occupies the right foreground. Its mast and part of the operator's cab are visible. It stands on the concrete floor, partially obscuring a yellow barrier post. The forklift appears stationary and is positioned near stacked pallets.

objects.label: yellow safety barriers
objects.observation: Yellow horizontal rails mounted on black posts, running along the left side of the aisle. They are freestanding and appear to delineate a walkway or restricted area. The barriers are positioned parallel to the aisle’s length and are not touching any other objects except their own posts.

objects.label: ceiling-mounted sign
objects.observation: A white rectangular sign with the number '2' in black, hanging from the ceiling via a metal bracket. It is located above the central aisle, near the top-left of the frame. The sign is suspended and does not touch any other surfaces or objects.

objects.label: emergency exit sign
objects.observation: A green square sign with a white cross symbol, mounted on a white wall. It is located above a doorway in the background, to the left of the central pallet stacks. The sign is affixed to the wall and points toward the doorway.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-32850", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
